quotes.text: In the recorded BCT6 accessibility triage, revision-based job results were stale. The investigation used the selected `push_id` to find the Linux accessibility job, then read that job's artifacts. Apply this when a Treeherder revision query may include another push; confirm the current push and task before attributing a failure.
